        for n in rt:
            s += demands[n]

        if not rt:
            return 0

        for k in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[k]][rt[k + 1]]
        return c

                    parent[x] = newrep

        cl = customers_list
        m = len(cl)
        for a in range(m):
            i = cl[a]
            di = matrix[depot][i]
            for b in range(a + 1, m):
                j = cl[b]
                s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
                pairs.append((s, i, j))
        pairs.sort(reverse=True)

        for s, i, j in pairs:
            ri = find_rep(i)
            rj = find_rep(j)
            if ri == rj:
                continue
            li = loads[ri]
            lj = loads[rj]

            j_at_start = route_j[0] == j
            j_at_end = route_j[-1] == j
